statement: Two visual artists, **Khushbu Patel** and **Manika K**, were invited to engage with the themes of sensation and pain, informed by insight from neuroscience. Their creations retain their artistic subjectivity and speculative imagination.

artists.name: Khushbu Patel
artists.label: Invited artist
artists.title: Diary Pages — Khushbu Patel
artists.intro: This work takes the form of a diary — not to document events, but to trace the undercurrents of experience. Page by page it moves through quiet encounters: attraction, distance, touch, introspection. Some images slip into the surreal; others carry echoes of Indian miniature painting, where scale and detail compress complex emotion into small spaces.

artists.name: Manika Kumari
artists.label: Invited artist
artists.title: Manika Kumari
artists.intro:
This work treats the body as a vessel for memory it cannot fully discharge — wrinkles, freckles, scars, sutures read as a trace left by experience that the mind has moved on from but the surface hasn't. Studies of skin in charcoal and pencil sit alongside a more speculative thread: a kinetic structure, still in concept, meant to enact how an unprocessed emotion changes shape as it passes from one body to the next — what breaks, what thickens, what residue it leaves behind.

Contact: [kmanika003@gmail.com](mailto:kmanika003@gmail.com)

sections.label: Towards a kinetic structure — a working note

items.caption: How does an unprocessed emotion move from one body to another? What shape does it take, what is added to it, and what changes when it's finally processed — sketched here as vessels that hold emotion in lines, breaking or thickening with each experience added to a life. The plan is a kinetic structure that changes form as it moves, documenting whatever residue it leaves.
